capability.title: Planning Truth and Executable Backlog Control
capability.outcome: One contradiction-aware, machine-readable backlog becomes the sole active planning control surface.
acceptance_criteria: Active planning names one sequence.
Every backlog story has evidence, boundaries, dependencies, acceptance and validation.
Stale plans cannot silently steer work.
validation: Backlog catalog contract passes in CI.

stories.title: Rebaseline Active Steering Sequence
stories.outcome: Containment-era steering is replaced by the merged REENTRY decision and a single current sequence.
acceptance_criteria: README and roadmap agree on current/next/later.
MCP freeze is historical, not active steering.

stories.title: Reconcile Planning Status Against Implemented PRs
stories.outcome: Implemented, superseded, conditional and truly open packages are distinguishable.
acceptance_criteria: All planning files receive lifecycle classification.
Implemented plans are archived or marked implemented.
Historical snapshots stop steering.
validation: Automated status inventory plus manual sample audit.

stories.title: Backlog Catalog CI Contract
stories.outcome: CI rejects duplicate IDs, unknown dependencies, cycles and incomplete DON-style work items.
acceptance_criteria: Catalog schema and dependency graph are validated.
Active sequence references valid IDs.
validation: Unit test for validator and Pipeline CI.

stories.title: Consolidate Search Intelligence Current-State Snapshot
stories.outcome: The June operational snapshot is either refreshed or unambiguously archived as non-authoritative.
acceptance_criteria: File no longer claims both primary and non-primary status.
Outdated immediate sequence cannot be mistaken for current.

stories.title: Close or Reclassify CONSISTENCY-001A
stories.outcome: The containment block reflects that REENTRY-001A exists and product planning resumed.
acceptance_criteria: Status is completed/superseded or exit gaps are explicitly listed.
No duplicate active steering remains.

stories.title: Repair FREEZE-002 Exit Criteria
stories.outcome: The maturity campaign has measurable entry, exit and non-entry conditions.
acceptance_criteria: Exit criteria cover each maturity lane, evidence age, operator usability and unresolved critical defects.

stories.title: Reconcile Ruff Transition Documentation
stories.outcome: The plan reflects completed critical/safe cleanup and the new hard CI gate while isolating remaining E402 work.
acceptance_criteria: Completed slices are marked complete.
Only E402 policy/cleanup remains open.
Final full Ruff target is explicit.

stories.title: Target-Profile Truth Decision
stories.outcome: The canonical target role is selected and versioned before search/matching/CV changes.
acceptance_criteria: Operator chooses canonical role family and transition wording.
Runtime profile, planning and application roadmap reference the same version.
validation: Profile contract tests and documentation alignment.
operator_decisions: Choose Data Engineer, ML/GenAI Engineer, Data & AI Reliability, or an explicit multi-profile model.

stories.title: Contradiction Regression Check
stories.outcome: Known mutually exclusive status/sequence claims are caught automatically.
acceptance_criteria: Checks cover active steering, current-truth labels and completed-vs-planned markers.
